heading: Sample setter
text:
### Sample setter [NSTG.5.2]

Registers the **C6** sample callback ([NSTG.5.3]) and the user pointer
handed back on every invocation. One per engine; registering again
replaces. Registering none is legal and drops samples silently, matching
the drop-oldest framing of a bounded backing.

Independent of the declaration callback ([NSTG.5.4]) — either may be
registered without the other.
